## Decision (autonomous scope call)

`Decision: re-scope #2027 to arm 2 only` — a plan-time magnitude check
comparing the plan's §9 projected wall against the intent's resolved SLURM
`--time` bin when no `--time-budget-hours` is declared. Arm 1 is recorded as
superseded by #2161; no duplicate guard is written. Rationale: this delivers
the surviving, explicitly-named content of the Goal at real coverage value,
while the alternative (archive-as-duplicate) would drop a live gap the Goal
names. Per `.claude/rules/auto-continuation.md` halt-criterion #1 autonomous
carve-out, a scope call is decided and executed, never parked.

Target surface is `verify_plan.py` (WARN-only, matching c46's stated
polarity: "NEVER FAILs — the runtime exit-2 refusals are the hard gate"),
not `dispatch_issue.py` — the projected wall is plan-resident and never
reaches the launch CLI. Existing machinery to compose from — no new
parsing needed:

- the §9 projected wall is ALREADY parsed structurally: c47
  (`c47_wall_cell_parseable`, L8566+) reads §9 `planned_wall_h` cells, and
  c48 consumes them through a `_ComputeRow` type
  (`_c48_booked_per_cell_wall_h`, L8774 — `planned_wall_h x width /
  n_cells`). Arm 2 reads the same rows.
- the dispatch argv (hence `--intent` and `--time-budget-hours` presence) is
  already extracted by c46's helpers: `_c46_command_candidates` (L8374),
  `_c46_argv_from_tokens` (L8441), `_c46_dry_parse` (L8410, returns the
  parsed namespace), `_c46_has_flag` (L8436).
- `slurm._DEFAULT_TIME_BUDGETS_HOURS` (`slurm.py` L553) is the bin table;
  `slurm.time_budget_hours()` (L581) is the resolution rule to mirror,
  including its raise-on-unknown-intent behavior.

Open design point for the plan (NOT blocking — resolvable from the
codebase): whether arm 2 lands as a new standalone check or as a third arm
inside `_c46_drift_arms`. Leaning standalone — c46 is a per-argv *parse*
check with no plan-body input, while arm 2 must join argv data to §9 table
data, and c46's docstring scopes it to "the two demonstrated drift shapes".
